## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g., "I'm having trouble analyzing logs because...")

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how it integrates into the existing C/Python architecture.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, architectural diagrams, or links to external tools (like new API integrations) here.
